\definecolor{paperblue}{RGB}{0,70,140}
\definecolor{paperred}{RGB}{145,35,35}
\definecolor{papergreen}{RGB}{0,105,80}
\definecolor{paperpurple}{RGB}{95,55,145}
\definecolor{boxbackcolor_black}{rgb}{0.96,0.96,0.96}
\definecolor{boxframecolor_black}{rgb}{0.2,0.2,0.2}
\newcommand{\riskterm}[1]{\textcolor{paperred}{#1}}
\newcommand{\geomterm}[1]{\textcolor{papergreen}{#1}}
\newcommand{\opterm}[1]{\textcolor{paperblue}{#1}}
\newcommand{\statterm}[1]{\textcolor{paperpurple}{#1}}
\newcommand{\interpretation}[1]{\par\smallskip\noindent\textcolor{paperpurple}{\textbf{Implication.}}~#1\par\smallskip}
\newcommand{\consequence}[1]{\par\smallskip\noindent\textcolor{paperblue}{\textbf{Consequence.}}~#1\par\smallskip}
\newcommand{\bzero}{\bm{0}}
\newcommand{\be}{\bm{e}}
\newtcolorbox{generalbox}[1]{
  breakable,colback=boxbackcolor_black,colframe=boxframecolor_black,
  fonttitle=\bfseries,title=#1,arc=1mm,boxrule=0.6pt,
  toptitle=1.5mm,bottomtitle=1.5mm,left=3mm,right=3mm,top=2mm,bottom=2mm,
  before upper={\phantomsection\addcontentsline{toc}{subsubsection}{#1}}
}
\hfuzz=0pt
\emergencystretch=2em
\allowdisplaybreaks[2]
